# AppHeader

The one sticky 56px bar at the top of every SongNodes page: hamburger, wordmark, the current page's title, and a fixed set of status and tools on the right.

`SongNodes.AppHeader` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.AppHeader titleLead="…" title="…" drawerOpen />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.AppHeader" title-lead="…" title="…" drawer-open="{{yes}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (AppHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `titleLead` * | `string` | Lead of the thin–bold page title, normally the module label ("Library"). |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold part of the page title ("Melbourne crate"). |
| `drawerOpen` * | `boolean` | Whether the navigation drawer is open (drives aria-expanded on the hamburger). |
| `drawerId` * | `string` | Id of the NavDrawer element, for aria-controls. |
| `onOpenDrawer` * | `() => void` | Called when the hamburger is pressed. |
| `mode` | `{ value: "play" \| "plan"; onChange: (mode: "play" \| "plan") => void }` | Play/Plan switch, shown only on the graph page. |
| `updatedAt` | `Date \| string` | When the page's data was last refreshed; shown relative with the absolute stamp in a tooltip. |
| `connection` | `"live" \| "reconnecting" \| "offline"` | Live-update connection state. |
| `onOpenSearch` * | `() => void` | Opens the CommandPalette (also bound to Ctrl/⌘ K and /). |
| `menuActions` | `MenuAction[]` | App-level secondary actions for the More actions menu. |
| `onMenuAction` | `(id: string) => void` | Called with the chosen menu action id. |

### MenuAction

One action shown in an OverflowMenu or ContextMenu.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id passed back to onSelect. |
| `label` * | `string` | Verb-first label in sentence case, e.g. "Export as CSV". |
| `icon` | `string` | Lucide icon name from assets/Icons. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Shortcut hint shown as a key cap, e.g. "F". |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | When set the item is aria-disabled and this reason is shown under the label. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | Destructive: status-bad text, placed last after a separator; label ends with "…". |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Makes it a menuitemcheckbox with this checked state. |
| `group` | `string` | Group heading this item sits under, e.g. "Route". |
